title: Relational Semantic Grounding for Test-Time Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.14721v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Test-Time Discovery (TTD) aims to recognize known classes and detect novel ones from a continuous unlabeled test stream after deployment. Existing TTD methods mainly rely on visual clustering or prototype comparison, and can only assign anonymous labels to discovered classes, leaving them difficult to interpret in open-world applications. In this paper, we propose SEGA, a Semantic Grounding with Attributes framework for TTD. SEGA leverages large language models to generate attribute-rich descriptions for known classes and constructs an attribute-anchored visual-semantic space during training. At test time, we introduce Relational Semantic Grounding (RSG), which grounds unknown samples with similar and dissimilar known-class anchors, prompts the LLM to generate candidate concepts, and reranks them in the learned semantic space. translated_title: 面向测试时发现的关联语义接地
translated_abstract: 测试时发现（TTD）旨在部署后从连续的无标注测试流中识别已知类别并检测新类别。现有的TTD方法主要依赖视觉聚类或原型比较，只能为发现的类别分配匿名标签，导致其在开放世界应用中难以解释。本文提出了SEGA，一个基于属性的语义接地框架，用于测试时发现。SEGA利用大语言模型为已知类别生成属性丰富的描述，并在训练阶段构建以属性为锚点的视觉-语义空间。在测试阶段，我们引入关联语义接地（RSG），利用相似和不相似的已知类别锚点对接未知样本，提示大语言模型生成候选概念，并在学习到的语义空间中对这些概念进行重排序。所选概念进一步用于置信度引导的测试时语义稳定。
tldr: SEGA框架利用大语言模型为已知类别生成属性描述并构建属性锚定的视觉-语义空间，通过关联语义接地在测试时为发现的未知类别赋予可解释的语义概念，突破了传统方法只能分配匿名标签的局限。
en_tdlr: SEGA leverages LLM-generated attribute descriptions to build an attribute-anchored visual-semantic space and introduces Relational Semantic Grounding to assign interpretable semantic concepts to newly discovered classes at test time, overcoming the anonymous-label limitation of existing test-time discovery methods.
